overview: Bangladesh is a country in South Asia, almost surrounded by India. Its capital and largest city is Dhaka. Bangladesh was the eastern part of Pakistan until it won independence in 1971. It is one of the most densely populated countries in the world and one of the biggest exporters of clothing. Bengali, also called Bangla, is the official language.

geography.text: Most of Bangladesh lies on the delta of three great rivers, the Ganges, the Brahmaputra and the Meghna, and is very low and flat, so floods are common. The summer monsoon brings heavy rain. In the south-west, the Sundarbans, the largest mangrove forest in the world, which Bangladesh shares with India, is home to Bengal tigers, and the country has a long coast on the Bay of Bengal.
